No files changed. ### Current repo - Branch: `main`, clean worktree; `main` is 3 commits behind `origin/main`. - PDP, footer, sites, and locale handling all live in `light-modules/advantech-templates`; `custom-lightmodule` is only scaffold/sample content. This should be a shared implementation, not regional modules. ### 1. Existing Footer contact configuration Configuration flow: `templates/pages/main.ftl` → `[@cms.area name="footer"/]` → page template footer area → `footer/footer` component → `footer-new.ftl`. Key files: - `light-modules/advantech-templates/templates/pages/home/home.yaml` - Declares the inherited `footer` area and allows `advantech-templates:components/footer/footer`. - `light-modules/advantech-templates/templates/components/footer/footer.yaml` - Component definition: ```yaml templateScript: /advantech-templates/templates/components/footer/footer-new.ftl dialog: advantech-templates:components/footer-new ``` - `light-modules/advantech-templates/dialogs/components/footer-new.yaml` - “Help Links” tab configures: `titleHelp`, `email`, `phone`, `chatLabel`, `chatLabelJs`, `formLabel`, `formUrl`. - All contact values are `i18n: true`. - `light-modules/advantech-templates/templates/components/footer/footer-new.ftl` - Renders the contact block: ```ftl

${content.titleHelp!}

${content.email!} ${content.phone!} ${cmsfn.decode(content).chatLabel!} ${content.formLabel!}
``` - `chatLabelJs` is decoded and emitted at the end of the footer. There is no dedicated footer-contact JavaScript; chat is author-provided HTML/JS. - `light-modules/advantech-templates/webresources/clientlibs/css/footer-new.scss` - Styles `.help_link-contact_info`; compiled output is `footer-new.css`. The manual import confirms the footer is authored CMS content under the home page footer area, but contains no actual contact values in the repository: - `light-modules/advantech-templates/__manual_import__/website.advantech.yaml` ### 2. PDP structure and safest insertion The PDP is a component placed in the standard page’s top-level `mainBody` list: - `light-modules/advantech-templates/templates/pages/standard/standard.yaml` ```yaml productDetails: id: advantech-templates:components/productDetails/product-details ``` - `light-modules/advantech-templates/templates/components/productDetails/product-details.yaml` - Inherits `ecommerce-templating:components/product-detail-v3`. - `light-modules/advantech-templates/templates/components/productDetails/product-details.ftl` - Product body starts at `section.productContainer` (line 97). - Main product layout is `.productMain` (line 110). - The product section closes at line 624. - The fixed add-to-cart bar follows at line 634. Safest minimal path: create a separate `pdpContactInformation` component and make it available only in the standard page’s `mainBody`. Authors place it immediately after the Product Dynamic component. This preserves its independent dialog/content, avoids changing the inherited ecommerce component definition, and follows the existing top-level component architecture. Do not add a nested Magnolia area inside `product-details.ftl`: there are no existing component-owned `[@cms.area ...]` patterns in this module, making that a higher-risk structural change. ### 3. Multilingual and fallback behavior Shared site-level settings already cover both regions: - `light-modules/advantech-templates/decorations/multisite/config.sites.ko-kr.yaml` - locales: `en_US`, `ko`; `fallbackLocale: ko` - `light-modules/advantech-templates/decorations/multisite/config.sites.en-eu.yaml` - locales: `en_US`, `de`, `fr`, `es`, plus test locales; `fallbackLocale: en_US` - `light-modules/advantech-templates/README.md` - Production locales: KR uses English/Korean; EU uses English/French/German/Spanish. For template-side fallback, reuse: - `light-modules/advantech-templates/includes/i18n.ftl` `getI18nField(content, "field")` resolves the base English property for English and otherwise reads `field_` with the base property as fallback: ```ftl [#return contentMap[field + "_" + currentLanguage]!contentMap[field]!""] ``` Use that helper in the new PDP section, rather than direct `content.field`, to make the “only one language maintained” case explicit. Note: it falls back when the localized property is absent, not when an authored localized value is deliberately blank. ### 4. Recommended implementation plan Add one shared standalone component, with author-configurable title and contact rows (email/phone/link/rich text as required), all `i18n: true`. Likely files: 1. New `light-modules/advantech-templates/dialogs/components/pdpContactInformation.yaml` - Fields matching the required PDP contact design. - Use `i18n: true` for all displayed text and links. 2. New `light-modules/advantech-templates/templates/components/pdpContactInformation/pdpContactInformation.yaml` - Freemarker definition linked to the new dialog. 3. New `light-modules/advantech-templates/templates/components/pdpContactInformation/pdpContactInformation.ftl` - Include `/advantech-templates/includes/i18n.ftl`. - Render only when at least one configured value exists. - Use `getI18nField`; resolve internal/external links using the existing switchable-link pattern from `footer-new.ftl`. 4. Update `light-modules/advantech-templates/templates/pages/standard/standard.yaml` - Add the component to `mainBody.availableComponents`. - No change to homepage, footer, or regional site definitions. 5. Update `light-modules/advantech-templates/webresources/clientlibs/css/pdp.scss` and generated `pdp.css` - Scope styles under a new `.pdp-contact-information` class. - No new dependency or JavaScript. Skipped: modifying `product-details.ftl`, adding a region module, duplicating footer configuration, or adding JS.
